verdicts.tldr: the pre-halt check reads config.toml, so a future halt_height cleared without a restart passes it and the running node still halts at the old height
verdicts.details: start.go:288-291 applies cfg.BaseConfig.HaltHeight through baseApp.SetHaltHeight once at startup, and gnoland UPGRADES.md:87-88 says `gnoland config set` only edits the file. An operator who finds a future value C below the voted height H, runs `gnoland config set halt_height 0` and re-checks sees 0, as section 6 asks, and the node still stops at C, out of step with the network, until someone restarts it; validators holding a third of the power doing so stall the chain short of H. Recovery is a restart with 0 before C. Same text at onyx VALIDATOR.md:147. The diff touches only the two docs, so the node behaves the same at the merge base; the misleading check is the branch's own text.
verdicts.evidence: Judge's rerun of the finder's script in the sandbox, gnoland built from df2c4ffca: 'config get before start: 6' / 'Halt height configured {"height": 6}' / 'config get after clearing: 0' / 'halt height 6 reached, node shutting down' / 'process alive 5s after the halt' / 'exited 2s after SIGTERM, rc=0'.

verdicts.tldr: 'The process does not exit' holds only for a node at the tip; a validator still block-syncing at the halt exits with code 2 and a restart-on-failure supervisor fires
verdicts.details: BaseApp.BeginBlock panics at baseapp.go:663-664 once the height passes haltHeight. Under block sync that call runs from poolRoutine's bcR.blockExec.ApplyBlock at reactor.go:536 with no recover: the reactor's only recover is respondRoutine's at :269, and none sits in tm2/pkg/bft/state/execution.go, proxy or the abci client; the consensus recover at consensus/state.go:652 covers only a node at the tip. The supervisor restarts the old binary, which the after-halt gate refuses below halt_min_version, so the operator meets a restart loop the section says cannot happen. The remedy is the same stop and switch. Same text at onyx VALIDATOR.md:149.
verdicts.evidence: reactor.go:269 is the only recover() in the reactor; grep over execution.go, proxy and abci/client returns none; gnoland UPGRADES.md:175 states the exit code 2 case.
